name.Description: Label of channels used for online recording (e.g., trig, raw_fdi, raw_apb, mep_ampl_fdi, pre_rms_fdi, mep_ampl_apb, pre_rms_apb)

TRIG.Description: Trigger channel marking stimulus onset or event codes

EMG.Description: Raw electromyography signal recorded from a muscle

MEP.Description: Online motor evoked potential amplitude channel, storing peak-to-peak EMG amplitude following TMS pulses

EMGRMS.Description: Online EMG root mean square channel, computed over the 100 ms window prior to each TMS pulse

units.Description: Physical unit of the recorded signal

status_description.Description: Reason for non-good status or notes (e.g., noisy channel, electrode detached)
